case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer and the clear overview of your terms.

Before we settle the conditions, two points from our records are worth considering:

Your on-time delivery was 79.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

With this in mind, we propose terms that give both sides planning security:

Our proposal: unit price EUR 25.66; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 42 days.

The longer contract term and the higher binding volume give you a firm, predictable base for your capacity planning. The lead time we ask for would also give us reliable supply. We value our long cooperation and would welcome your view on this proposal.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your data regarding past deliveries and pricing. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

We accept the increased volume of 23,400 units and the 24-month contract term. Which volume can you commit to?

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €34.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €32.10 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. To ensure reliable execution of this volume, the lead time must remain at 54 days. 

This offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
